column2: Retain Antiochus’s upper-country journey and Elymais described as a wealthy city in Persia. The source’s geographical description is not corrected to a modern historical reconstruction.

Retain the rich temple, golden coverings, breastplates and weapons attributed to Alexander son of Philip. First reigned among the Greeks remains the narrative’s claim, not an editorial historical correction.
column3: Does coverings denote shields or another protective object here? Retain the broader inherited wording pending material-vocabulary review.

column2: Retain attempted seizure/plunder and failure because the inhabitants learned the plan. Could not preserves inability rather than voluntary abandonment.
Retain resistance, flight, great sorrow and intended return to Babylon. The infinitive purpose does not establish that he had already reached Babylon.
Retain an unnamed reporter arriving in Persia and reporting the Judean armies’ rout. No messenger name or new campaign date is supplied.
Retain Lysias’s strong force and defeat, followed by the opposing side’s growth through captured weapons and spoils. The inherited at first for the first-position expression remains provisional.
column3: Does in first positions mean at first, among the foremost or another leadership relation? Also review the unexpressed change to the victorious group as plural subject.

column2: Retain removal of the abomination, high walls around the sanctuary and Beth-zur, his city. The possessive is not silently removed to harmonize geography or ownership.
column3: Whose city is Beth-zur in this reported clause, and how does as before attach to restoration and walling? The source’s pronoun and ambiguity remain.

column2: Retain astonishment, shaking, bed, illness from sorrow and frustrated intentions. The narrator’s stated emotional cause is not converted into a modern medical diagnosis.
Retain many days, renewed sorrow and his belief that he was dying. Again is supported by the renewal verb, not an inserted independent event.
Retain all royal Friends, sleep leaving his eyes and collapse in heart from anxiety. My heart has collapsed naturally unfolds the personal verb with heart as its sphere.
Retain the inner question, distress and storm image, and his claim to have been kind and beloved during his rule. This self-assessment is not endorsed by the translator.
Retain remembered evils, all silver/gold vessels and the sending to destroy Judah without cause. The purposeless/groundless phrase remains provisional as without cause, not in vain.
column3: Does the final idiom emphasize lack of justification or lack of result? Context supports the former but does not replace lexical review.

column2: Retain his recognition of the evils’ cause, Behold and dying in great sorrow in a foreign land. The wording attributes this interpretation to his speech.
Retain Philip as one of the Friends appointed over the whole kingdom. Do not merge him with Lysias or replace the named appointment with an inferred office title.
Retain diadem, robe and ring, with responsibility to guide/raise the son Antiochus for kingship. The regalia remain separate items and no coronation ceremony is invented.
Retain Antiochus’s death there in year 149. The place remains deictic and the source year is not converted to a modern era.
Retain Lysias appointing the son he had raised and naming him Eupator. From youth is contextual for younger, and the similar royal names are not conflated.
column3: Does the comparative younger describe the son’s age when raised or distinguish him as the younger Antiochus? The inherited phrase is provisional.

column2: Retain the citadel group hemming Israel around the holy places, seeking harm continually and supporting nations. Do not reduce the three actions to only a siege.
Retain Judas’s resolve to remove them and assembly of all people for siege. The collective scope remains tied to the mobilized group.
Retain year 150, the siege and singular construction of artillery platforms/engines. The technical platform term is provisional, without an invented mechanism.
Retain escape from the blockade and joining by some ungodly Israelites. The groups are distinguished rather than making all escapees Israelites.
Retain the appeal for judgment and vengeance for their brothers. Ordinary you addresses the human king; the question keeps both requested actions.
Retain present willingness to serve your father, despite the narrative’s notice of his death. Do not silently backshift the source tense to solve the apparent chronology.
Retain besieged it, estrangement from us, deaths among those found and plundered inheritances. It follows the printed feminine reference rather than being changed to an unsupported us.
column3: How precisely does the feminine siege object resume the citadel in this speech? The inherited pronoun keeps the selected difficulty visible.

column2: Retain stretched hand, not only us and all their territories. Their is the printed territorial possessive, not automatically your kingdom.
column3: Whose territories are meant by their in the accusation? Do not resolve this by importing an alternative possessive.

column2: Retain Behold, today’s encampment against the Jerusalem citadel and the fortified sanctuary/Beth-zur. The temporal immediacy belongs to the speakers’ report.
Retain urgency, a greater future threat and inability to restrain them. Act against is a broad contextual rendering of the anticipatory seizure/action verb.
column3: Does the verb require forestalling or seizing them rather than the broader act against? The tactical nuance remains open.

column2: Retain anger and the gathering of Friends, army commanders and those in charge of reins. The reins expression is not silently expanded to a specific cavalry or chariot office.
column3: Does the reins phrase identify a military office or another royal administrative role? The literal image is retained pending review.

column2: Retain hired forces from other kingdoms and islands of the seas. No individual islands or recruiting powers are supplied.
Retain one hundred thousand infantry, twenty thousand cavalry and thirty-two trained elephants. Historical plausibility is not used to alter the selected counts.
Retain Idumea, Beth-zur, long fighting and engines, followed by the defenders’ sortie and burning. Defenders makes the contextual subject change explicit without naming an unmentioned leader.
Retain Judas leaving the citadel and camping at Beth-zechariah opposite the royal camp. The place name is preserved provisionally rather than identified with a modern site.
Retain the king’s early start, rapid army movement toward Beth-zechariah, preparation and trumpets. Rapidly renders the army’s impetus without inventing an exact speed.
Retain showing the elephants blood of grapes and mulberries to ready them for war. Do not replace showed with fed or intoxicated, neither of which is expressly stated.
Retain distribution among phalanxes, a thousand armoured men and five hundred picked cavalry per beast, chain mail and bronze helmets. Do not reconcile the totals by changing each or a count.
Retain the difficult beforehand positioning and constant accompaniment without departure. The sequence remains provisional rather than converted to a precise drill reconstruction.
column3: How does before the time relate to wherever the beast was? The tactical interpretation and syntax need specialist review.

column2: Retain covered wooden towers, securing devices, four fighting men on each and its Indian driver. The selected running text says four; previously reported competing counts have not been independently collated.
column3: Is Indian an ethnic designation alone or already a conventional driver designation here? Driver is a contextual supplement; no apparatus claim is made.

column2: Retain remaining cavalry on both wings, threatening and shielding the phalanxes. The two participles are military interpretations, not exact identification of movements.
column3: Does the shaking/brandishing participle specify weapons, threat or another action, and what is the precise relation of shielding to the phalanxes?

column2: Retain sun flashing on gold/bronze shields, mountains reflecting the flash and the fire-torch simile. No physical explanation replaces the vivid image.
Retain part of the army high and others low, moving securely and in order. The distribution is qualitative, with no invented percentages or formations.
Retain everyone shaken by the multitude’s sound, marching and clash of arms, and the very large strong army. The repeated multitude remains in the English cadence.
Retain Judas’s approach and six hundred of the royal army falling. The selected count is exact here, unlike approximate figures in other encounters.
Retain Eleazar Avaran seeing royal armour and the tallest beast, and thinking the king was on it. The king’s presence is his inference, not established narration.
Retain self-giving both to save his people and to gain an everlasting name. Do not suppress the second motive or transform the phrase into an explicit statement of a ritual sacrifice.
Retain his bold charge, killing right and left and the formation parting on both sides. The four directional expressions are not collapsed into a generic advance.
Retain slipping under the elephant, thrusting beneath it, killing it, its fall onto him and his death. The instrument and precise wound are not supplied by the terse verb.
column3: How should the elliptical thrust-under action be expressed without inventing a named weapon or anatomical target? Retain the broad provisional rendering.

column2: Retain seeing royal strength/onrush and withdrawing. The unexpressed plural subject is contextual and is not replaced by a newly named commander.
Retain the royal men’s approach to Jerusalem and the king’s camp in Judea and against Zion. The two place expressions are not reduced to only one destination.
Retain peace with Beth-zur, departure because provisions could not sustain enclosure, and the land’s sabbath. Do not reduce the land-rest reference to a weekly day.
Retain the king’s seizure of Beth-zur and installation of a guarding garrison. Peace and subsequent occupation remain in the narrated sequence.

Retain the long sanctuary siege and the full list of platforms, engines, fire/stone throwers, small scorpions and slings. The weapon vocabulary remains provisional and not a modern engineering specification.
column3: How does the final shooting-missiles-and-slings phrase attach within the list, and what mechanisms do the scorpion diminutives denote?

column2: Retain defenders making engines against enemy engines and fighting many days. The reciprocal equipment contrast and prolonged duration remain.
Retain empty storage vessels, the seventh year and refugees consuming the remaining provisions. The two explanations for scarcity are preserved without blaming a newly named group.
Retain only a few in the holy places, famine prevailing and each scattering home. Only naturally emphasizes the small remnant; the distributive each remains.
Retain Lysias hearing about Philip’s appointment by the still-living king to raise his son for kingship. The subordinate report continues into the next unit.

Retain return from Persia and Media with the royal troops and Philip’s attempt to assume affairs. The return and present intention are not collapsed into an accomplished takeover of the whole kingdom.

Retain urgent departure, dwindling men, scarce food, the strong place and pressing kingdom affairs. Pressed for departure is a provisional rendering of the consent/gesture expression, not a settled lexical finding.
column3: Does the verb mean signaled assent, agreed or urged departure? The inherited wording requires fuller review alongside the surrounding haste.

column2: Retain giving right hands and making peace with the men and their whole nation. The embodied pledge is not replaced by an unmentioned written treaty.

Retain establishing freedom to follow former customs and the admission that abolishing those customs provoked anger. Right is an English expression of the guarantee, not a separate legal noun in the Greek.
Retain approval by king/commanders, singular sending and the other party’s acceptance. The agents remain differentiated across the clauses.
Retain oaths by king and commanders and departure from the stronghold on those terms. Their leaving is contingent on the sworn agreement.
Retain the king seeing the place’s strength, rejecting his oath and ordering demolition of the surrounding wall. The violation is explicit and must not become an innocent revision of terms.
Retain hurried return, Philip controlling Antioch, fighting and forcible seizure. No death of Philip is supplied beyond what this unit states.
